# Asset licenses

Every non-code asset in this repo, and where it came from.

## 3D vehicle models (`public/models/*.glb`)

**Original placeholder geometry, generated by `scripts/generate-placeholder-models.mjs`.**
Boxes, cylinders, and simple panels (windshield/rear/side glass,
headlights, taillights, mirrors) -- not a real car brand, model, or logo --
built programmatically with
[`@gltf-transform/core`](https://gltf-transform.dev/) to prove out the
3D-card pipeline (status badge, fuel/charge gauge, recoloring by the
material named `body`) end to end. License: CC0 / public domain -- these
are our own generated geometry, free to use, modify, or replace.

**These are intentionally stylized placeholders, not real vehicle models.**
Real CC0 low-poly asset packs exist (e.g. Kenney's Car Kit) but this
session's network policy doesn't allow fetching from general asset-hosting
sites (kenney.nl, opengameart.org, itch.io) -- only a small allowlist
(npm, GitHub, a few others). To use a real pack: either add the asset
host to the environment's network settings (cloud environment menu in the
session's title bar -> Edit -> Network access) so a future session can
fetch it directly, or download it yourself and hand the `.glb` files to
Claude Code. Either way: drop the replacement under `public/models/` with
the same filename (`sedan.glb`, `hatchback.glb`, `suv.glb`, `van.glb`,
`pickup.glb`, `motorcycle.glb`), keep a material literally named `body` so
recoloring keeps working, and add an entry here with the source and
license.

## Fonts

Source Sans 3 and Source Serif 4, loaded via `next/font/google` in
`src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx`. Both are
[SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://scripts.sil.org/OFL), served and
self-hosted by Next.js's font optimization (no runtime request to Google
Fonts).
